# anypoint_private_space_upgrade (Resource)

Schedules (or cancels) a runtime upgrade for a Private Space.

Deleting this resource cancels the scheduled upgrade (`DELETE .../upgrade`); it does not roll back an upgrade that has already completed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anypoint_private_space_upgrade" "upgrade" {
  org_id           = var.root_org
  private_space_id = var.private_space_id
  opt_in           = true
  date             = "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `opt_in` (Boolean) Whether to opt in to the scheduled upgrade.
- `org_id` (String) The organization id where the private space is defined.
- `private_space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the private space to upgrade.

### Optional

- `date` (String) The scheduled upgrade date. If omitted, the platform default schedule is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) This resource's unique id, equal to the private space id.
- `scheduled_update_time` (String) The date the upgrade is scheduled for.
- `status` (String) The upgrade status (e.g. QUEUED).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# In order for the import to work, you should provide the private space ID:
#  {PRIVATE_SPACE_ID}
# NOTE: org_id is not part of the import ID and must be set in the resource config.

terraform import \
  -var-file params.tfvars.json \        #variables file
  anypoint_private_space_upgrade.upgrade \  #resource name
  e60d1779-13eb-4892-9fb3-803087c14988  #private space id
```
